<shared#28>.description: Search public workspace files with a Python re regex. Returns path, 1-based line and snippet per match with the snapshot digest. Large results are truncated with next_cursor.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a truncated search

path.description: Optional file or directory scope within the public tree

pattern.description: Python re regex searched per line

<shared#28>.name: search

<shared#28>.description: Read a line range of one public workspace file. Returns path, start_line, end_line, total_lines, the snapshot digest and the file content_hash. Truncated output carries next_cursor.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a truncated read

end_line.description: Last line to read, inclusive; omit for end of file

<shared#28>.name: read_range

command.description: Command string, e.g. uv run pytest tests

timeout_sec.description: Optional time limit in seconds; omitted uses the default, larger values apply the maximum
